'''Jer Blankuna''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] agent of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan. He was married to [[Gelune Blankuna]].

==Biography==
At some point, the Desilijic clan were competing against newcomer crime lord [[Kaeline Ungasan]] and his minion, a young Twi'lek by the name of [[Ree]], for the control of [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] in [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]. The Desilijic family ordered the Blankunas to pretend to be Ree's parents and hire some independent agents to track Ree. The Hutts forged some records of the previous family history, including a rags-to-riches tale of shipping industry, and placed the Blankunas in a [[Alderaan orbital mansion|mansion in the orbit]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] where they were supposed to live, surrounded by Human servants.<ref name="G2" />

The Blankunas conducted a job interview with the candidates in their presumed home, sending a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 freighter]], the ''[[Fleen]]'', to collect them. The Twi'leks made a convincing performance as worried parents, with Mrs. Blankuna retiring to a different room to cry. They hired the candidates; talked about a [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooinian]] [[Dug/Legends|Dug]], [[Benkudi]], who had supposedly contacted the Blankunas to negotiate the sale of information on Ree; and provided their new employees with a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] including images of Ree. The datapad included a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] so that the Desilijic [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] mercenaries and their leader [[Davon Gitta]] could find these agents as soon as they find Ree.<ref name="G2" />

As soon as the interview was over, the Desilijic moved the Blankunas and changed their names. The orbital mansion was re-sold to Alderaanian Humans [[Sumda Tend|Sumda]] and [[Jylle Tend]].<ref name="G2" />
